definitions.explanation: At an angle that is neither perpendicular nor horizontal. Often used to describe direction, position, or angle of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斜|はす}⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The post office is diagonally across from the station.
examples.notes: [Note: {斜|はす}⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧ is a common compound meaning 'diagonally opposite']

examples.japanese: {斜|はす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}えた→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want you to stop that contrary attitude.
examples.notes: [Note: {斜|はす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ is an idiom meaning 'to be cynical/standoffish']

notes:
WRITING: Also written as ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧ (more common in modern usage). The reading はす is somewhat old-fashioned but still used in set phrases.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {斜|はす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to be cynical, to take a standoffish attitude)
- {斜|はす}⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧ (diagonally across)
- {斜|はす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut diagonally)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧ (diagonal - more common reading)
- ⟦{対角線|たいかくせん}→対角線：08121_taikakusen⟧ (diagonal line - geometric term)
